pages.title: Void Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 4 Obsidian, 4 Ender Pearls and 1 Chorus Fruit.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor: immunity to fall damage; immunity to void damage; falling into the void instantly teleports you back to your spawn point (or to your bed / respawn anchor if one is set).
The grid above shows the layout: obsidian in the corners, ender pearls on the edges, chorus fruit in the center.
